title: Slow checkout page
signature: High page load latency during peak hours
notes: Caused by unoptimized product image loading; fixed in v1.8.2

title: Duplicate order creation on network retry
signature: order-service can create duplicate orders if a client retries POST /api/orders after a network timeout without an idempotency key
notes: Fixed in v2.3.8; unrelated to payment gateway timeouts

title: Search index staleness
signature: Product search results lag behind catalog updates by up to 10 minutes
notes: Known limitation of the current indexing pipeline; not a bug

title: ConnectionPoolTimeoutException in payment-gateway-adapter
signature: A ConnectionPoolTimeoutException in payment-gateway-adapter logs is a known signature of an undersized connection pool relative to current traffic; cross-reference against deployment history for any recent pool size change
notes: Recurred more than once - see previous incidents; both prior occurrences traced back to a pool size reduction

title: Notification email formatting glitch
signature: Emails occasionally render with broken HTML in older webmail clients

title: Refund webhook delay
signature: Refund confirmation webhooks to merchants can lag by several minutes under load
notes: Separate from charge processing; does not affect charge success or failure

title: Login session timeout too aggressive
signature: Users report being logged out after 10 minutes of inactivity
notes: By design but frequently reported as a bug; UX review pending

title: Database failover reconnect delay
signature: order-service returns elevated 500s for several minutes during a database failover event
notes: Root cause: failover automation does not update the connection string fast enough
